B = int(input())
arr = list(map(int, input().split()))
import heapq

pq = []
e = 0
o = 0
for i in range(n - 1):
    ele = arr[i]
    if ele % 2 == 0:
        e += 1
    else:
        o += 1
    if e == o:
        heapq.heappush(pq, abs(arr[i] - arr[i + 1]))

ans = 0
while B >= 0 and pq:
    B -= heapq.heappop(pq)
    if B < 0:
        break
    ans += 1

print(ans)
